title: MINDSET: Energy-based Schema Evolution for Long Conversational Agent Memory

paragraphs.en: Long conversational agents have become essential in our daily lives. They must remember what was said long back in order to help us efficiently complete a task without needing the user to repeat instructions and context repeatedly. However, the main issue is that instructions and context change over time and so the agents must be able to adapt accordingly. A useful memory system should preserve both current and historical states, distinguish stale information from active knowledge, retrieve evidence appropriate to the query and avoid repeatedly invoking a large language model to rewrite prior interactions. We introduce MINDSET , a memory controller that stores a conversation as immutable episodes and organizes them into versioned schemas through minimum-energy state transitions. Each incoming episode may reinforce, supersede, split or create a schema. The transition decision balances representation distortion, contradiction, historical damage, fragmentation and internal inconsistency, while hysteresis prevents isolated contradictions from prematurely rewriting stable memory.
paragraphs.zh: 长对话智能体已成为我们日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。 为了帮助我们高效完成任务，它们必须记住很久之前说过的内容，而无需用户反复重复指令和上下文信息。 然而，主要问题在于指令和上下文会随时间变化，因此智能体必须能够相应地适应这些变化。 一个实用的记忆系统应当同时保留当前和历史状态，区分过时信息与有效知识，检索与查询相关的证据，并避免反复调用大型语言模型来重写先前的交互内容。 我们提出了 MINDSET——一种记忆控制器，它将对话存储为不可篡改的片段，并通过最小能量状态转换将其组织成带版本标识的结构。 每个新传入的片段都可能强化、取代、拆分或创建一个新的结构。 这种转换决策会在表现失真、矛盾、历史信息破坏、碎片化和内部不一致之间取得平衡，同时通过滞后效应防止孤立的矛盾过早地改写稳定的记忆。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MINDSET against 5 memory systems on a reproducible sample of 850 questions (700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench). MINDSET obtains the highest observed LoCoMo answer F1 while significantly improving retrieval ranking (Recall@8, MRR and nDCG@8) over the second best method LightMem (p<0.01 after Holm correction). It obtains the highest observed scores on MemoryAgentBench although the relative difference is low. Ablations identify controlled fragmentation and schema-aware assignment as the largest contributors to answer quality. Additionally, a 700-question cross-model evaluation with GLM-4.7 and Gemma-4-31B supported model independence. These results show that long-term memory can be better handled as constrained state management rather than continual summarization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个可复现的 850 个问题样本（700 个 LoCoMo + 150 个 MemoryAgentBench）上，将 MINDSET 与 5 种记忆系统进行了对比评估。 MINDSET 获得了观测到的最高 LoCoMo 答案 F1 值，同时在检索排名（Recall@8、MRR 和 nDCG@8）方面显著优于第二好的方法 LightMem（经 Holm 校正后 p<0.01）。 尽管相对差异较小，但它在 MemoryAgentBench 上获得了观测到的最高分数。 消融分析表明，受控碎片化和模式感知分配是对答案质量影响最大的两个因素。 此外，与 GLM-4.7 和 Gemma-4-31B 进行的 700 个问题跨模型评估验证了模型的独立性。 这些结果表明，长期记忆更适合以受约束的状态管理方式处理，而非持续摘要。

paragraphs.en: A conversational agent must remember not only what was said, but also what changed over time. With changing preferences, retaining only the original preference will produce stale answers, while retaining only the latest statement erases the context required to answer questions about the transition. Storing both in an undifferentiated vector index leaves the model to resolve the contradiction repeatedly. Full-history prompting preserves the complete record, but incurs recurring inference cost and remains vulnerable to context limits and the “lost in the middle” effect Liu et al. (2024) . Summarization reduces context length but may blur the context needed to verify an answer.
paragraphs.zh: 对话智能体不仅要记住曾经说过的话，还要记住随时间发生的变化。 当偏好发生变化时，仅保留原始偏好会导致答案过时，而仅保留最新陈述则会抹去回答关于转变过程问题所需的上下文。 将两者都存储在一个未区分的向量索引中，会让模型反复解决这种矛盾。 完整历史提示法能保留全部记录，但会产生重复的推理成本，并且仍然容易受到上下文限制和“中间丢失”效应的影响 Liu et al. (2024) 。 摘要生成可以缩短上下文长度，但可能会模糊验证答案所需的上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: This problem is common in agent memory. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) Lewis et al. (2021) provides language models with external evidence, while dense passage retrieval Karpukhin et al. (2020) and sentence embeddings Reimers and Gurevych (2019) make semantic access efficient. Memory-based agents have introduced reflection Park et al. (2023) ; Shinn et al. (2023) , virtual context management Packer et al. (2024) , forgetting Zhong et al. (2023) , graph-based organization Gutiérrez et al. (2025) , learned memory operations Yu et al. (2026) and benchmark-specific consolidation Zhang et al. (2026) ; Ma et al. (2026) . These systems show the importance of memory but lack in a core area. The central challenge in long conversational agents is state evolution under contradiction i.e. deciding whether new evidence should update an existing one, coexist as a contextual branch or be stored as a new memory.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题在智能体记忆中十分常见。检索增强生成（RAG）Lewis et al. (2021) 为语言模型提供了外部证据，而密集段落检索 Karpukhin et al. (2020) 和句子嵌入 Reimers and Gurevych (2019) 则使语义访问变得高效。基于记忆的智能体已引入了反思 Park et al. (2023) ; Shinn et al. (2023) 、虚拟上下文管理 Packer et al. (2024) 、遗忘机制 Zhong et al. (2023) 、基于图的组织方式 Gutiérrez et al. (2025) 、可学习的记忆操作 Yu et al. (2026) 以及针对基准测试的巩固方法 Zhang et al. (2026) ; Ma et al. (2026) 。这些系统展示了记忆的重要性，但在一个核心领域仍存在不足。长期对话智能体的核心挑战在于矛盾状态下的演化，即需要决定新证据是更新现有证据、作为上下文分支共存，还是存储为新的记忆。

paragraphs.en: MINDSET addresses this problem directly. It maintains immutable conversational episodes and a compact layer of versioned schemas. A schema is not a generated summary; it is a structured index over supporting and exceptional episodes, with temporal validity, active or historical status and predecessor-successor links. For each incoming episode, MINDSET evaluates four possible actions - reinforce , supersede , split and new under a local energy function. The energy penalizes representation distortion, unresolved contradiction, historical damage, unnecessary fragmentation, and internal inconsistency. Temporal and contextual signals determine action feasibility, while hysteresis prevents isolated contradictions from prematurely rewriting stable memory. This design separates two responsibilities that are often conflated. The memory controller determines how experience should be organized and which episodes are relevant, while the language model receives a bounded evidence packet and produces the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: MINDSET 直接解决了这个问题。 它维护不可变的对话片段和一个紧凑的带版本控制的结构层。 结构并非生成的摘要；它是一个对支持性片段和例外片段进行结构化索引的机制，具有时间有效性、当前或历史状态以及前驱-后继链接。 对于每个传入的片段，MINDSET 会基于局部能量函数评估四种可能的操作——强化、取代、拆分和新建。 该能量函数会对表示失真、未解决的矛盾、历史损害、不必要的碎片化和内部不一致性进行惩罚。 时间和上下文信号决定了操作的可行性，而滞后效应则防止孤立的矛盾过早地改写稳定的记忆。 这种设计分离了通常被混为一谈的两项职责。 记忆控制器决定经验应如何组织以及哪些片段具有相关性，而语言模型则接收一个有界证据包并生成最终答案。

paragraphs.en: We formulate conversational memory evolution as minimum-energy selection over explicit state-transition actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将对话记忆的演化表述为在显式状态转换动作中选择最小能量路径的问题。

paragraphs.en: We introduce provenance-preserving versioned schemas that distinguish active states, historical states, contextual branches and exceptions without replacing the underlying episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了能够保留来源信息的版本化模式，该模式能够在不替换底层事件序列的前提下，区分活跃状态、历史状态、上下文分支和异常。

paragraphs.en: We provide a thorough and fair evaluation across LoCoMo and MemoryAgentBench, covering six memory systems, ablations and 3 answer models to show generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 LoCoMo 和 MemoryAgentBench 上进行了全面且公正的评估，涵盖六种记忆系统、消融实验以及 3 种答案模型，以展示其泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines parametric generation with non-parametric evidence Lewis et al. (2021) . Dense passage retrieval Karpukhin et al. (2020) established a widely used neural retrieval paradigm, Sentence-BERT Reimers and Gurevych (2019) made efficient semantic matching practical, and BM25 Robertson and Zaragoza (2009) remains competitive when exact entities, dates, or rare lexical cues are important. Reciprocal rank fusion Cormack et al. (2009) combines heterogeneous rankings without requiring score calibration, while maximal marginal relevance Carbonell and Stewart (1999) balances relevance and diversity. MINDSET builds on this and modifies the memory index: raw episodes are supplemented with versioned schema routes, historical-state access and provenance expansion back to the original evidence.

paragraphs.en: Early agent-memory systems demonstrated several complementary strategies. Generative Agents stores observations, generates reflections, and retrieves memories to support behavior Park et al. (2023) ; ReAct interleaves reasoning with environment-facing actions Yao et al. (2023) ; MemGPT treats context management as a virtual-memory problem Packer et al. (2024) ; and Reflexion stores linguistic feedback as episodic memory rather than modifying model weights Shinn et al. (2023) . MemoryBank combines dialogue memories, summaries and personality descriptions Zhong et al. (2023) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的智能体记忆系统展示了多种互补的策略。 Generative Agents 存储观察结果、生成反思并检索记忆，以支持其行为 Park et al. (2023)；ReAct 将推理与环境交互动作交替进行 Yao et al. (2023)；MemGPT 将上下文管理视为一个虚拟内存问题 Packer et al. (2024)；而 Reflexion 则将语言反馈作为情景记忆存储，而非修改模型权重 Shinn et al. (2023)。 MemoryBank 结合了对话记忆、摘要和性格描述 Zhong et al. (2023)。

paragraphs.en: MINDSET makes memory evolution an explicit choice among four state transitions: reinforcing an existing schema, superseding a historical state, creating a contextual branch and starting a new schema. This formulation is related in spirit to event segmentation in cognition Zacks and others (2007) , complementary learning systems Mcclelland et al. (1995) , and energy-based learning LeCun et al. (2006) . We do not claim a biologically faithful model. Instead, they motivate the engineering principle behind MINDSET.

paragraphs.en: Retrieval methods can emit memory units of very different size. We therefore normalize them before generation. paragraphs.en: MINDSET performs no gradient training and makes no provider call during ingestion or retrieval. Its learned components are frozen off-the-shelf local encoders. If n n episodes have already been stored, insertion compares a bounded set of nearby active schemas; retrieval constructs bounded direct and schema pools before reranking. The implementation therefore avoids both an unbounded prompt at answer time and repeated generative rewriting at write time.
paragraphs.zh: MINDSET 在摄入或检索过程中不进行梯度训练，也不调用任何提供商服务。 其已学习的组件是预训练好的本地编码器，且已被冻结。 如果已经存储了 n 个 n 集，插入操作会对比一组有限的邻近活跃模式；检索操作则会先构建有限的直接池和模式池，再进行重新排序。 因此，该实现既避免了回答时出现无界提示，也避免了写入时重复进行生成式重写。

paragraphs.en: We use a frozen manifest of 700 questions from LoCoMo Maharana et al. (2024) , 70 from each of ten conversations. The category counts are 151 single-hop, 151 temporal, 96 multi-hop, 151 open-domain, and 151 adversarial questions. As a secondary dataset, we use MemoryAgentBench (MAB) Hu et al. (2026) . We use 150 samples from benchmark-instance files: 125 in-context-learning examples and 25 recommendation examples. The five ICL source groups contribute 25 instances each, and the recommender contributes 25. We therefore use 850 questions in total. This is done intentionally to keep API costs manageable while also providing sufficient breadth for fair evaluation. The exact IDs and order are stored in the manifest and will be released with the codebase for reproducibility. Model transfer is evaluated on the complete frozen LoCoMo benchmark used by the primary experiment.

paragraphs.en: The primary model is gpt-oss-120b from Cerebras. All six methods use the same answer instructions, deterministic temperature 0, a maximum output reservation of 4,096 tokens, structured JSON validation, and completeness retries. paragraphs.en: For LoCoMo we report answer F1 and retrieval Recall@8, Precision@8, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), nDCG@8 Järvelin and Kekäläinen (2002) and evidence recall. Text normalization removes punctuation and articles and applies Porter stemming. Temporal, multi-hop, and open-domain questions use token F1; single-hop questions admit multiple reference answers; adversarial questions are correct only when the response abstains with "No information available" or equivalent benchmark-recognized wording. MAB uses its native metrics: first-line exact match for ICL and Recall@5 for recommendation. We additionally report deterministic normalized token F1 for ICL and set F1@5 for recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LoCoMo，我们报告答案的 F1、检索的 Recall@8、Precision@8、平均倒数排名（MRR）、nDCG@8（Järvelin 和 Kekäläinen，2002）以及证据召回率。 文本规范化会移除标点和冠词，并应用 Porter 词干提取。 时间性、多跳和开放领域问题使用标记 F1；单跳问题允许多个参考答案；对抗性问题仅在响应以“无可用信息”或基准认可的等效措辞拒绝回答时才算正确。 MAB 使用其原生指标：ICL 采用首行精确匹配，推荐采用 Recall@5。 我们还额外报告了 ICL 的确定性规范化标记 F1，并为推荐设定了 F1@5。

paragraphs.en: On the ten LoCoMo conversation clusters, MINDSET significantly improves Recall@8, MRR and nDCG@8 over LightMem, the closest method across our study (mean differences + 0.1758 +0.1758 , + 0.1207 +0.1207 , and + 0.1361 +0.1361 , respectively; Holm-corrected p = 0.00977 p=0.00977 for each). Against Nemori, the gains in Recall@8 ( + 0.2082 +0.2082 ), MRR ( + 0.3045 +0.3045 ) and nDCG@8 ( + 0.2724 +0.2724 ) are also significant (Holm-corrected p = 0.00977 p=0.00977 for each). Thus, the tests support a significant retrieval-ranking advantage over both strongest baselines. For answer F1, MINDSET obtains the highest observed value. Its gain over long context is significant (mean difference + 0.1489 +0.1489 , 95% cluster-bootstrap CI [ + 0.1094 , + 0.1857 ] [+0.1094,+0.1857] , Holm-corrected p = 0.00977 p=0.00977 ). Gains over Vector RAG, Nemori, and MemoryBank are also significant at p < 0.05 p<0.05 (Holm-corrected p = 0.04297 p=0.04297 , 0.02930 0.02930 , and 0.01562 0.01562 , respectively). The gain over LightMem remains directionally positive but is not statistically confirmed ( + 0.0256 +0.0256 , p = 0.24023 p=0.24023 ). We use two-sided exact paired sign-flip permutation tests over all 2 10 = 1,024 2^{10}=1{,}024 conversation-cluster sign assignments and cluster bootstrapping at the conversation level, with Holm correction within each metric family. This design accounts for non-independence among questions drawn from the same history.
paragraphs.zh: 在十个 LoCoMo 对话簇上，MINDSET 相较于我们研究中表现最接近的方法 LightMem，在 Recall@8、MRR 和 nDCG@8 方面均有显著提升（平均差异分别为 +0.1758、+0.1207 和 +0.1361；每项的 Holm 校正 p 值为 0.00977）。 与 Nemori 相比，Recall@8（+0.2082）、MRR（+0.3045）和 nDCG@8（+0.2724）的提升同样显著（每项的 Holm 校正 p 值为 0.00977）。 因此，这些测试表明 MINDSET 在这两种最强基线方法上均具有显著的检索与排序优势。 在答案 F1 方面，MINDSET 获得了观测到的最高值。 相较于长上下文方法，其提升显著（平均差异为 +0.1489，95% 簇自助置信区间为 [+0.1094, +0.1857]，Holm 校正 p 值为 0.00977）。 相较于 Vector RAG、Nemori 和 MemoryBank 的提升在 p < 0.05 水平上同样显著（Holm 校正后的 p 值分别为 0.04297、0.02930 和 0.01562）。 相较于 LightMem 的提升方向虽为正，但统计上未达显著性（平均差异为 +0.0256，p = 0.24023）。 我们对所有 2^10 = 1,024 种对话簇符号分配以及对话层面的簇自助法进行了双侧精确配对符号翻转置换检验，并在每个指标族内应用了 Holm 校正。 这种设计考虑了从同一历史中抽取的问题之间的非独立性。

Its recommendation Recall@5 is 0.14 compared with MemoryBank’s 0.10 and a softer ICL token F1. paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate MINDSET using GLM-4.7 and Gemma-4-31B to show generalization across models. MINDSET remains best with GLM-4.7. paragraphs.en: Long-term conversational memory is not always about preserving the most text. We show that it can be handled by maintaining a changing state without erasing the path by which that state changed. MINDSET achieves this using immutable episodes, versioned schemas and minimum-energy transitions (reinforcement, supersession, contextual splitting and new memory).
paragraphs.zh: 长期对话记忆并不总是意味着保留最多的文本内容。 我们证明，通过维护一个动态变化的状态，同时不抹除该状态演变的路径，就可以实现这一点。 MINDSET 使用不可变的事件记录、带版本标识的模式以及最小能量转换（强化、替代、上下文拆分和新记忆）来实现这一目标。

paragraphs.en: Across the frozen GPT-OSS experiments, this design produces the best observed LoCoMo answer and way better retrieval-ranking results. The cross-model backbone experiments across GLM and Gemma showed generalization without needing retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 在一系列针对 GPT-OSS 的冷冻实验中，这种设计产生了目前观察到的最佳 LoCoMo 答案，并且检索排序结果也显著提升。 该设计也迁移到了 MAB 结果中，尽管绝对指标仍然较低，且差异并不显著。 消融实验表明，性能提升与提案的结构有关：基于能量的分配和受控的碎片化比单纯扩大检索覆盖范围更为关键。 在 GLM 和 Gemma 上进行的跨模型骨干网络实验显示，无需重新训练即可实现泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: We show complete statistical tests computed on our primary dataset, LoCoMo. All tests use paired per-question scores from frozen run artifacts. Answer F1 and evidence recall use all 700 questions; ranking metrics use the 696 questions with nonempty gold evidence, matching the aggregation used in the main results table. Both the bootstrap and the two-sided exact sign-flip permutation test operate on the ten conversation clusters, preserving all questions from a conversation as one dependent unit. We report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm-adjusted p p -values within each metric family. Positive differences favor MINDSET. W-T-L denotes per-question wins, ties and losses. Mean differences are computed from unrounded per-question values. The cluster-level design guards against artificially narrow uncertainty estimates caused by treating questions from the same conversation as independent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了在主要数据集 LoCoMo 上计算出的完整统计检验结果。 所有检验均使用来自冻结运行产物的每道题的配对得分。 答案 F1 和证据召回率使用了全部 700 道题；排名指标则使用了 696 道具有非空黄金证据的题目，与主结果表中使用的聚合方式一致。 自助检验和双侧精确符号翻转置换检验均基于十个对话簇进行，将同一对话中的所有问题作为一个依赖单元予以保留。 我们在每个指标族内报告了 95% 的自助置信区间和经过 Holm 调整的 p 值。 正值差异表明 MINDSET 更优。 W-T-L 分别表示每道题的胜利、平局和失败次数。 平均差异是根据未经四舍五入的每道题数值计算得出的。 簇级设计可防止因将同一对话中的问题视为独立而导致的置信区间估计人为过窄的问题。

paragraphs.en: The frozen LoCoMo-700 MINDSET run ingests 5,882 dialogue episodes from the ten histories needed by those 700 questions. These episodes are memory input, not additional evaluation questions. The controller produces 179 schemas: 168 active and 11 historical. paragraphs.en: We vary one parameter at a time around its frozen value while keeping the exact 700-question manifest and all retrieval settings fixed. As in the main table, retrieval metrics average the 696 questions with annotated gold evidence; the four unannotated questions remain in the manifest but are excluded from ranked retrieval aggregation. This diagnostic is local and makes no answer-model or judge calls. Because these parameters act during memory construction, we report retrieval and structural behavior rather than reuse answers generated from a different evidence set.

paragraphs.zh: 无来源扩展：通过选定的记忆单元进行检索，而不扩展模式来源和连续性锚点。

paragraphs.en: We reserve a separate 300-question LoCoMo development set for hand-tuning MINDSET’s compatibility coefficients, energy weights, transition thresholds, hysteresis margins and retrieval-coverage parameters before the primary evaluation. The set is disjoint from the frozen LoCoMo-700 manifest at the question-ID level and contains 75 examples from each available category (categories 1, 2, 4, and 5); category 3 has no remaining examples because it is fully represented in the primary manifest. Selection is done after excluding every question in the primary 700 LoCoMo samples used for the main paper. Questions are sorted by the SHA-256 key, the first 75 questions in each available category are selected and the selected records are sorted globally by the same key. No primary-test question is used for parameter selection. The complete manifest, including exact question IDs, source indices, category labels and source-manifest hashes will be released alongside the codebase upon publication to make development selection and parameter tuning fully reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: 在主要评估之前，我们预留了一个包含 300 道题的独立 LoCoMo 开发集，用于手动调整 MINDSET 的兼容性系数、能量权重、转换阈值、滞后余量和检索覆盖参数。 该集合在问题 ID 层面与冻结的 LoCoMo-700 清单互不重叠，并包含每个可用类别（类别 1、2、4 和 5）中的 75 个示例；由于类别 3 在主要清单中已完全覆盖，因此没有剩余示例。 选择过程是在排除主论文所用主要 700 LoCoMo 样本中的每一道问题之后进行的。 问题按 SHA-256 密钥排序，每个可用类别中的前 75 个问题被选中，然后选中的记录按同一密钥进行全局排序。 没有任何来自主要测试集的问题被用于参数选择。 完整的清单（包括精确的问题 ID、源索引、类别标签和源清单哈希值）将在发布时与代码库一同公开，以确保开发选择和参数调整完全可重复。
